All actual payload checks, 3,444 source and duplicate deliveries, six reports, 318 snapshots, 304 Axiom headers, three historical cutoffs and fifteen faults pass. New main-only bundle regression and actual offline distribution pass; old version remains retired.

issues.observed_failure: Offline Git bundle clone returned success but selected unborn master; subsequent git rev-parse HEAD failed with exit 128.
issues.root_cause: A bundle containing refs/heads/main alone has no remote HEAD; clone used the host default branch master.
issues.correction: Explicit --branch main in verifier and runbook; new patch version and fresh per-version certification workspace.
required_closure: Real main-only Git bundle fixture under host default master passes
Actual distributed bundle check and all 70 tests pass
Old version remains retired; no accepted data silently overwritten

retirement.reason: Offline distribution check failed: main-only bundle cloned with host default master instead of selecting main. Never business-accepted. Preserve payload; recertify corrected packaging as v1.0.1.

failed_unpublished_attempts.cause: Frozen native exporter rejected an audit output directory outside its own output/data root. No package was sealed or published.
failed_unpublished_attempts.correction: Use a fresh version-specific native output under the frozen producer output root; keep the actual validation databases in the fresh audit workspace.
